title: Contents Sworn under a Duplicate Claim Number — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
On the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own), a second first notice for the same date of loss opens a duplicate claim number; contents already sworn under that number counts against a new contents proof of loss.

**Rule.** The contents amount already sworn under a duplicate claim number reported for the same date of loss is settled as follows: when contents proofs of loss were filed under that number, it is the amounts sworn on them; when no contents proof of loss was filed for the date of loss under either number but contents payments were issued under that number, it is those payments less the contents payment items voided under it; otherwise it is nothing.

## Judgement table

| Under the duplicate claim number | Under either number for the date of loss | Amount counted |
|---|---|---|
| contents proofs of loss filed | — | the total sworn on them |
| no contents proof of loss | no contents proof of loss under either number; contents payments issued under the duplicate number | those payments less voided items |
| no contents proof of loss | a contents proof of loss exists under the other number | nothing |
| nothing filed or paid | — | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Two claim numbers for the 14 October loss; a contents proof of loss of 6,000.00 sits under the duplicate number: 6,000.00.
- No contents proof of loss under either number; 4,000.00 of contents payments issued under the duplicate number with 500.00 voided: 3,500.00.
